SET enable_external_access=false;
CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO test_21890_macro(q) AS TABLE
WITH sel AS (
	SELECT unnest(string_split(q, ',')) AS tag,
	       row_number() OVER () AS node_id
)
SELECT s.tag, s.node_id
FROM sel s
WHERE s.tag = 'a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
	  SELECT 1
	  FROM sel args
	  WHERE args.tag = 'b'
	    AND s.node_id > args.node_id
  );
WITH inputs(q) AS (VALUES ('b'), ('a,a'))
SELECT i.q, m.*
FROM inputs i, test_21890_macro(i.q) m
ORDER BY i.q, m.tag, m.node_id;

WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (
	SELECT i, CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'long string payload ' || i::VARCHAR END s,
	       [i, NULL, i + 1] payload
	FROM range({rows}) r(i)
)
SELECT count(*) = {rows},
       coalesce(sum(l.i), 0) = {rows}::BIGINT * ({rows} - 1) / 2,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.s IS DISTINCT FROM
           CASE WHEN r.i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'long string payload ' || r.i::VARCHAR END
           OR l.payload IS DISTINCT FROM [r.i, NULL, r.i + 1]) = 0
FROM c l JOIN c r USING (i);

WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (
	SELECT i, 'long string payload ' || i::VARCHAR AS s, [i, NULL, i + 1] AS payload
	FROM range({rows}) r(i)
)
SELECT * FROM c WHERE i < (SELECT count(*) FROM c);

       count(*) FILTER (WHERE i != rowid OR s IS DISTINCT FROM 'long string payload ' || i::VARCHAR
                          OR payload IS DISTINCT FROM [i, NULL, i + 1]) = 0
FROM parallel_scan_ordered;

	 ANTI JOIN csp_pm_c_deletes d ON tbl.name = d.name);
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c1, 0) = 0 OR COALESCE(orders_by_customer.c2, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)
FROM csp_pm_a
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       COUNT(product_info.name1) AS c1,
	       COUNT(product_info.name2) AS c2
	FROM csp_pm_o
	INNER JOIN csp_pm_i ON csp_pm_o.id = csp_pm_i.order_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_p.id,
		       category_info.name1 AS name1,
		       category_info.name2 AS name2
		FROM csp_pm_p
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT csp_pm_c.name,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name1,
			       csp_pm_c.short_name AS name2
			FROM csp_pm_c
			WHERE csp_pm_c.demand <= 2::SMALLINT
		) AS category_info
		ON csp_pm_p.category = category_info.name
		WHERE csp_pm_p.alert_at >= ('18:30:00.178')::TIMETZ
	) AS product_info
	ON csp_pm_i.product_id = product_info.id
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS orders_by_customer
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = orders_by_customer.customer_id
LEFT JOIN csp_pm_tx
ON csp_pm_a.id = csp_pm_tx.a_id
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
	       MAX(repeated_order.v) AS v
	FROM csp_pm_o
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT csp_pm_o.customer_id,
		       MIN(DISTINCT csp_pm_o.customer_id) AS v
		FROM csp_pm_o
		GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
	) AS repeated_order
	ON csp_pm_o.customer_id = repeated_order.customer_id
	WHERE csp_pm_o.flag != FALSE
	GROUP BY csp_pm_o.customer_id
) AS unreferenced_branch
ON csp_pm_a.customer_id = unreferenced_branch.customer_id;

SELECT i, CASE WHEN i % 4 = 0 THEN i END AS v,
       CASE WHEN i % 4 = 0 THEN i::VARCHAR END AS s,
       NULL::BIGINT AS null_v
FROM range(65536) t(i);
SET threads={threads};
SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE last_v IS DISTINCT FROM i - i % 4
       OR last_s IS DISTINCT FROM (i - i % 4)::VARCHAR
       OR first_i IS DISTINCT FROM 0
       OR last_null IS NOT NULL
       OR n IS DISTINCT FROM i + 1
)
FROM (
    SELECT i,
           last_value(v IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_v,
           last_value(s IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_s,
           first_value(i) OVER w AS first_i,
           last_value(null_v IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last_null,
           count(*) OVER w AS n
    FROM collection_input
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) t;
SELECT count(*) FROM (
    SELECT i, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
    FROM collection_input
) t WHERE n IS DISTINCT FROM i + 1;

)
FROM (

CREATE TABLE window_input(p INTEGER, q INTEGER, v INTEGER);
INSERT INTO window_input VALUES (1, 1, 1), (1, 1, NULL), (1, 2, 3), (2, 1, 4);
CREATE TABLE window_results AS
SELECT
	first_value(v) OVER common_window AS plain_first,
	first_value(v IGNORE NULLS) OVER common_window AS nonnull_first,
	sum(v) OVER common_window AS plain_sum,
	sum(DISTINCT v) OVER common_window AS distinct_sum,
	sum(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 1) OVER common_window AS filtered_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_sum,
	sum(v ORDER BY q ASC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_asc,
	sum(v ORDER BY q DESC) OVER common_window AS argument_order_desc,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS partition_p_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS partition_q_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p, q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
	) AS included_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY p, q
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
		EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW
	) AS excluded_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN p PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS dynamic_p_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		ORDER BY v
		ROWS BETWEEN q PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
	) AS dynamic_q_sum,
	sum(v) OVER (
		PARTITION BY q, p
		ORDER BY v
		RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
	) AS reordered_partition_sum,
	lead(v, 1, -1) OVER common_window AS next_value,
	lag(v, 1, -1) OVER common_window AS previous_value
FROM window_input
WINDOW common_window AS (
	PARTITION BY p, q
	ORDER BY v
	ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
);
SELECT count(*) FROM window_results;
